title: AT-ST Dual Cannon
caption: AT-ST Dual Cannon (V)
game_text: Deploy on your AT-ST. May target a character, creature or vehicle for free. Draw destiny. Target hit (may lose 2 Force to make it lost instead) if destiny +X > defense value, where X = the number of your AT-STs present. May fire repeatedly for 2 Force each time.
lore: High rate of fire used for anti-personnel operations. Enhanced design from prototype used in the Battle of Hoth.

notes: Non-unique (no dot; wiki Unrestricted). Green weapon frame, banner VEHICLE WEAPON. No inline icons; slip text matches the stub. Lore matches the scan. Base scan only at 350 px; copyright (Endor, 1999) not legible. Modern: Virtual Block 3 only (VB3 -pre, 350 px).
